messages.content: I’ll sell the initial stored energy in the first hour, recharge using midday solar clipping and regulation-down service, then discharge at the highest day-ahead price. I’ll also hold RRS in the evening. The dry run is feasible and ends with the required 100 MWh; I’ll adjust energy dispatch as live conditions emerge.
